title: RHYTHMIC CORPUS CHOPPER -- slice a loop at its hits and resequence them

sections.heading: USING IT
lines: Needs the FluCoMa, EARS (with bach) and Rhythm and Time Toolkit packages.
Load loop: drop an audio file here. The waveform shows it and it is sliced at each hit.
Slices: how many hits were found. Sens (0-100): higher finds more slices.
Play: starts and stops the sequencer. Tempo: 40-240 BPM (default 120).
Steps (1-64): sequence length. Steps loop back over the slices if there are fewer.
Mode Straight: every step plays a slice. Euclid: only Euclid k hits spread over the steps play.
Scramble: shuffles the step order (each slice once per cycle).
Auto bars: toggle on to reshuffle automatically every N bars (default 4).

sections.heading: HOW IT WORKS
lines: fluid.bufonsetslice~ finds the hit points; ears.split~ cuts the loop into one buffer per slice.
rtt.clock~ runs a bar-rate ramp that is split into steps.
Each step picks a slice buffer name, and groove~ plays that slice in stereo to dac~ 1 2.
